allow: PowerShell(try { $r = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "http://localhost:3000/api/strategy-analysis/stocks?strategy=8.%20%E5%88%86%E6%AD%A7%E5%8F%8D%E5%8C%85%E7%AD%96%E7%95%A5&trade_date=2026-06-05&score_min=70&score_max=80"; $d = $r.data; "Total stocks: $\($d.stocks.Count\)"; $d.stocks | ForEach-Object { "$\($_.symbol\) $\($_.stock_name\): score=$\($_.score\) win=$\($_.is_win\) close_today=$\($_.close_today\) close_next=$\($_.close_next\)" } } catch { "Error: $_" })

PowerShell(try { $r = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "http://localhost:3000/api/strategy-analysis/status-score-trend?strategy=turnover_vol&status=%E5%90%AF%E5%8A%A8%E7%AA%81%E7%A0%B4&score_min=10&score_max=20&days=30"; "Status: $\($r.data.status\)"; "Score range: $\($r.data.score_range\)"; "Trend points: $\($r.data.trend.Count\)"; $r.data.trend | ForEach-Object { "$\($_.trade_date\): win_rate=$\([math]::Round\($_.win_rate,1\)\)% total=$\($_.total\)" } } catch { "Error: $_" })
